scope: Pure string scanning microbenchmark; not complete activation, filesystem IO or product latency
newExpression: const key = collisionKey(target); names.find(name => name !== target && collisionKey(name) === key)
data: Synthetic ASCII filenames file-00000.txt...; missing.txt forces complete scan
sampling: Three repeats, alternating old/hoisted execution order; 200000 visited sibling strings per sample
limitations: The deterministic reduction is repeated normalization of an immutable requested component, not a filesystem cache.
All fresh readdir/lstat, spelling, alias, link and nested-repository guards remain in place.
Mixed/noisy duration samples do not prove a universal latency reduction or statistical significance; complete-API ablation is separate.
Directory fanout still causes repeated current sibling scans and can remain quadratic.
The first stdin run's non-ASCII source literals were not used as Unicode proof; five comparator examples were rerun using ASCII Unicode escapes.
